servinfo.title: Identification Plate
servinfo.ptxt: Identification plate (1) is installed at the center pillar lower side on the right or left side body outer panel.
The identification plate has the following information:

item.ptxt: Model code (6) including the model information shown in Model Code Description below.

servinfosub.title: Model Code Description
servinfosub.ptxt: The composition of the model code and the description of each digit are as follows.
The model code is composed of 9 characters.

item.ptxt: The first character indicates body type.
The 3rd character indicates door (3 door, 4 door, etc.).
The 4th and 5th characters indicate the combination of engine and transmission.
The 6th character indicates the grade etc.
The 7th character indicates the type of model.
The 8th and 9th characters indicate the market code.

servinfosub.ptxt: The market code is used in this manual for easier and exact distinction of the vehicle specification.
